links.outcome: Local performance against clinician gold-standard reference at prespecified threshold
links.effect: Prospective gold-standard validation (n=218): PPV 98.28%, NPV 95.68% at the prespecified threshold; retrospective ROC-AUC 0.99, PR-AUC 0.92.
links.quote: In prospective gold-standard validation (n=218), the positive predictive value was 98.28%, and the negative predictive value was 95.68% at the prespecified threshold.

unlisted_practices: DSM-5-aligned clinician chart review to establish gold-standard labels for validating an EHR-embedded phenotype
Using a computable silver-standard label for retrospective model development

screen.reason: Describes the prospective implementation and EHR deployment of a real-time random-forest model to identify opioid use disorder in emergency departments, evaluated with prospective chart validation.
